canvaExport.description: Export an existing Canva design to a downloadable file. This converts a design that already exists in the account.
canvaExport.outputHint: {"type":"object","properties":{"export_url":{"type":"string","description":"Download URL for the exported design file"}}}

canvaUpload.description: Upload an existing image or video file into the Canva library. The file must already exist.

heygenListAvatars.description: List the avatars already in the account. Returns each avatar id, name, and preview image. This does not generate a video.

geminiGenerate.description: Generate a video from a text prompt describing the scene, characters, and length.
